description: This file defines functions and classes for string substitution using format strings with positional notation, supporting various argument types and providing an API for string formatting and appending.

classes.name: Arg
classes.description: A class representing an argument for substitution, capable of implicit conversion from various types including strings, numbers, booleans, pointers, and user-defined types.

methods.name: Substitute
methods.description: Formats a string by replacing placeholders with provided arguments, supporting up to 10 arguments.

methods.name: SubstituteAndAppend
methods.description: Formats a string by replacing placeholders with provided arguments and appends the result to an existing string, supporting up to 10 arguments.
